sloka: न ह्यविद्धं तयोर्गात्रे बभूवाङ्गुलमन्तरम् ।नानिर्भिन्नं न चास्तब्धमाकराग्रादजिह्मगैः ।। ६.४५.२० ।।।।
transliteration: na hyaviddhaṁ tayorgātre babhūvāṅgulamantaram ।nānirbhinnaṁ na cāstabdhamākarāgrādajihmagaiḥ ।। 6.45.20 ।।।।

translations.english: Not an inch of space on their bodies remained without being pierced. Not even a part of the body was left unshaken, unhurt, or wounded.
